address: via Giuseppe Gioachino Belli 21, Rome, 00193, Italy
bio: Although the rooms at this restaurant are simple and minimalist in style, the cuisine, skilfully prepared by chef Ciro Alberto Cucciniello, is bursting with colour and flavour. The dishes are inspired by different culinary traditions from all over Italy and then reinterpreted with a personal touch by the chef with pleasing and occasionally exciting results....
